events.title: Which party will win the Senate in 2026?
Republican Senate seats after the 2026 midterm elections?

rivals.note: Other published forecasts of the same question, each read on the date shown. Hand-entered from the source page, because none of them publishes a feed. They are never an input to this model.

forecasters.note: '73 out of 100'; median outcome D+4, 52 seats. Same page timestamp. Unchanged from 2026-10-10.

forecasters.name: ElectIt
forecasters.note: Same model and variant. 52 seats, 95% range [46,57]; 9 of 35 races competitive. Note their Post-Nomination variant gives a much lower Senate figure; this row is Model + All Polls.

forecasters.name: Poliwave
forecasters.note: 51 seats, 48-54 in 80% of runs. D 57% / R 34% / 10% 'chance independents decide control' -- Osborn is a third outcome rather than assigned to a party, so this is the one rival whose Nebraska treatment is known and differs from ours.

forecasters.note: Page states 'Last updated Oct 24, 8:24 PM'; 56% and a 51-49 seat split.
